name: Grilled Pork Chop over Strawberry-Kiwi Spinach Salad with Pistachios

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add pork chops and grill until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (454 g) pkgs strawberries
6 kiwifruit
3 (142 g) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince shallots. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, sesame seeds, Worcestershire, sugar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
3 tbsp sesame seeds
2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Trim and thinly slice strawberries. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and quarter kiwis lengthwise, then slice crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl, along with the spinach, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with sliced pork and enjoy!
